scores.claim_text: CACI generated 75.4% of FY2025 revenues from DoD agencies and 95.7% from federal contracts overall.
supports: usaspending.query_dod_contracts: 2662 awards, $7.6B total to CACI entities
usaspending.query_federal_presence: 19 UEIs resolved; CACI INTERNATIONAL INC parent shows $4.48B FY snapshot
scores.interpretation: Past federal/DoD revenue concentration is structurally confirmed by USAspending. pentagon_jbook does not list CACI as a primary contractor on indexed PEs (defense IT services rarely map to RDT&E PE lines), so this is verified via USAspending not J-Book.

scores.claim_text: Top ten contracts = 46.4% of FY2025 revenue / $4.0B.
supports: usaspending top awards include W15QKN15C0049 IPPS-A ($733M), HS002123F0020 background investigations ($652M), FA882316C0004 NSS work ($600M)
scores.M_value: Top awards by amount: $733M IPPS-A, $652M background-investigation TO, $600M NSS — consistent with a concentrated top-ten composition
scores.interpretation: USAspending top-award amounts and recipient structure (CACI-ISS, CACI INC FEDERAL, CACI NSS) corroborate the concentrated top-ten contract narrative. No J-Book hit available because these are large IDIQ task-order vehicles (services) rather than R-2 PE lines.

scores.claim_text: Spectrum Superiority / EW / photonics positioning as forward DoD revenue driver.
supports: pentagon_jbook.query_program_funding(program_name='Electronic Warfare') returned 3 candidate Air Force EW PEs; primary match Multi-Platform Electronic Warfare Equipment (0207040F) = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS, but CACI not listed as a contractor on that PE.
scores.M_value: primary_match PE 0207040F status=UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS (last funded FY24 $14.3M); 2 other EW PEs in corpus (no contractor field)
scores.interpretation: CACI's marketing taxonomy ('Spectrum Superiority') does not map to any indexed J-Book PE. The one EW PE the corpus does flag UNFUNDED (Multi-Platform EW Equipment, an AF aircraft EW pod program) is not a CACI line item per the filing — CACI is sub-tier on RF/EW services, not a prime on an R-2 line. Coverage gap, not adverse signal. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: C3I / software-defined SIGINT + EW for multi-domain command and control.
supports: pentagon_jbook(program_name='SIGINT') = Airborne SIGINT Enterprise PE 0304260F, FUNDED_STEADY, FY26=$90.65M (FY24 $113M, FY25 $85M, FY26 $91M)
scores.M_value: PE 0304260F Airborne SIGINT Enterprise, status=FUNDED_STEADY, FY26 funded_M=90.65
scores.interpretation: Closest J-Book SIGINT PE is FUNDED_STEADY at ~$90M/yr — not large in absolute terms but indicates the SIGINT mission area is not being defunded. CACI is not named as the prime, but as a services subcontractor the SIGINT envelope is steady. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Space domain awareness, intel fusion, integrated logistics — forward Space Force exposure.
supports: pentagon_jbook(program_name='Space Domain Awareness') = PE 1208248SF SDA/Planning/Tasking SW, FUNDED_GROWING, FY24 $130M, FY25 $146M, FY26 $201M
scores.M_value: PE 1208248SF status=FUNDED_GROWING, FY26 funded_M=200.97 (+54% over 2 yrs)
scores.interpretation: Space Force SDA software PE is growing fast — supports CACI's stated forward Space narrative. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Full-spectrum cyber capabilities — offensive + defensive — forward revenue from DoD/IC cyber programs.
supports: pentagon_jbook(program_name='Cyber') primary match Rapid Cyber Acquisition PE 0305881F = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS (FY24 $8.5M then $0/$0). Other matches include Cyber Security Initiative 0305103C (Lockheed/System High primes), Cyber Resiliency Weapon Systems-ACS, Acq Workforce Cyber/Network/Bus Sys.
scores.M_value: primary PE 0305881F (Rapid Cyber Acq) UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS; J-Book corpus does not list CACI as a prime on any indexed Cyber PE
scores.interpretation: The narrative-loadbearing 'Cyber' area is mixed in the J-Book: at least one named cyber PE has gone to zero, and the prime-contractor cyber PEs name competitors (Lockheed, System High) not CACI. CACI is a services player in cyber, not a J-Book prime, so the verifiability is partial. Downgrading from SEVERE because CACI's cyber work flows through services task orders that USAspending confirms in aggregate; the J-Book miss is informative but not existential. MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY.

scores.claim_text: Enterprise IT solutions for ~50 federal agencies.
supports: usaspending.query_federal_presence resolved 19 distinct UEIs across CACI INTERNATIONAL INC and subsidiaries (CACI INC-FEDERAL, CACI NSS LLC, CACI-ISS LLC, CACI TECHNOLOGIES LLC, etc.) consistent with broad multi-agency footprint
pentagon_jbook(EITaaS) = NOT_FOUND (procurement contract vehicle, not an R-2 PE)
scores.M_value: n_ueis_resolved=19; parent CACI INTERNATIONAL INC FY snapshot $4.48B; subsidiary CACI INC-FEDERAL $3.27B
scores.interpretation: Multi-agency enterprise IT presence corroborated by 19 resolved UEIs across CACI subsidiaries. Forward demand for federal enterprise IT modernization remains broad-based; J-Book is the wrong instrument for this O&M / services class. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Seven acquisitions in three fiscal years including Azure Summit (RF/EMS/photonics) — rollup thesis.
supports: usaspending: CACI AZURE SUMMIT TECHNOLOGY LLC = 59 awards / $53M, including DARPA ASCOT phase contracts and Navy RF/tuner integration work — consistent with the stated RF/photonics thesis
scores.M_value: n_awards=59, total=$53.09M; top awards N0016419FJ192 ($8.4M VPX/tuner integration), N6523619C8011 ($7.2M DARPA ASCOT Phase 1)
scores.interpretation: Azure Summit's USAspending profile (Navy RF integration + DARPA ASCOT) is coherent with CACI's stated reason for acquiring it (electromagnetic spectrum / photonics). Rollup logic checks out at the entity-level. acq_coherence M-source requires additional kwargs not in scope here. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Mission and Engineering Support: naval architecture, platform integration, weapons system sustainment.
scores.M_value: NOT_FOUND (services category, not an R-2 PE)
scores.interpretation: Naval architecture and platform modernization are services/sustainment categories that do not appear as discrete PEs in the R-2 J-Book corpus. Per rubric heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND for services categories outside corpus scope is UNVERIFIABLE, not adverse. USAspending shows CACI subs holding large Navy/NAVSEA-style task orders separately, but no J-Book read possible.

scores.claim_text: Patents and trade-secret IP exist but are not material to operations (control claim).
supports: uspto_odp.query_assignee(CACI) returned 112 applications, 50 granted patents pre-cutoff under 'CACI, INC.- FEDERAL'; recent grants in radio delay calibration and ceramic waveguide filter consistent with the EMS/RF positioning.
scores.interpretation: Patent footprint is real and skewed toward RF/EW (consistent with EMS/Spectrum Superiority claims), but small enough that the company's own characterization (IP not materially relied upon) is reasonable. PASS.

supports: dol_h1b_lca returned only 1 LCA filing for CACI INC-FEDERAL in 2024 (one Software Developer in Cumming, GA, $131,671)
scores.interpretation: DOL H1B is the wrong instrument to size a 25,000-person US-cleared workforce: CACI's labor force is overwhelmingly US-citizen cleared personnel (security clearances required for IC/DoD work), so H1B undercount is expected and not adverse. Headcount itself was not independently testable with the available M-sources. UNVERIFIABLE.
